statements.headline: Hazardous Weather Outlook
statements.summary: Today and tonight. Another round of at least scattered thunderstorms is possible Sunday afternoon and evening along a cold front. The level of the severe threat remains uncertain. However, the stronger storms may produce isolated instances of damaging wind gusts and large hail.

details.label: Today's Hazards
details.text: Today and tonight. Another round of at least scattered thunderstorms is possible Sunday afternoon and evening along a cold front. The level of the severe threat remains uncertain. However, the stronger storms may produce isolated instances of damaging wind gusts and large hail.

details.label: Extended Outlook
details.text: Monday through Saturday. No hazardous weather is expected at this time.
